content: After three years of unwavering hard work, a dream has finally found its name—Pundir Legal Associates, Mussoorie. This is not just a law firm; it is an emotion, built with faith, sacrifice, and resilience. As I begin this new journey, I remain proudly committed as the Managing Director of Legal Angles Patna. Grateful to everyone who believed in me and stood by my side. Here's to new beginnings and a lifelong commitment to justice.🧿🧿
comment: Building a firm is only the first milestone; the real test is creating consistent systems for client trust, matter management, and ethical growth as the practice expands across jurisdictions.
